documentTemplates.Boarding pass:
Please provide a copy of your boarding pass for the disrupted flight(s).
You can find your boarding pass in the confirmation email from the airline,
in the airline's mobile app, or at the airport check-in counter. A photo or
scan of the physical boarding pass is also acceptable.
documentTemplates.Ticket number (13-digit):
Please provide your 13-digit ticket number.
You can find this number on your booking confirmation email (usually labelled
"Ticket Number" or "e-Ticket Number"), in the airline's app under "My Trips",
or by contacting the airline's customer service directly.
documentTemplates.PNR / Booking Reference:
Please provide your PNR (Passenger Name Record) or Booking Reference.
This is a 6-character alphanumeric code (e.g. ABC123) found in your booking
confirmation email, the airline app under "My Bookings", or on your printed
itinerary.
documentTemplates.ID / Passport:
Please provide a clear, colour copy of your valid passport or national ID.
The full name, date of birth, and document number must be clearly visible.
A high-resolution photo or scan is required — blurry or partial images cannot
be accepted.
documentTemplates.Signed Power of Attorney:
Please sign and return the attached Power of Attorney document.
Print the document, sign it by hand in the designated signature field, and
return a clear scan or photo of the signed copy.
documentTemplates.Booking confirmation:
Please provide a copy of your original booking confirmation.
This is the email or PDF receipt you received when you completed your booking,
showing the flight details, passenger name, and booking reference.
documentTemplates.Proof of delay:
Please provide proof of your flight delay.
If the delay is publicly recorded (e.g. Flightradar24, FlightAware), we may
already have access to it. If not, please provide any official communication
from the airline acknowledging the delay, such as an email, SMS, or airport
notification.
documentTemplates.Proof of cancellation:
Please provide proof of your flight cancellation.
This can be an email or SMS from the airline confirming the cancellation, or
any official notification you received. If you were rebooked, please also
include the details of the replacement flight offered.

rejectionTemplates.Visa/Documentation Rejection:
After a thorough review of your case, we regret to inform you that we are
unable to pursue your compensation claim. The reason for this decision is that
based on the documentation and information provided, the disruption to your
journey appears to be related to visa or documentation issues, which fall
outside the scope of the applicable passenger rights regulations. As a result,
we are unable to represent you in this matter.
rejectionTemplates.Short Delay / No Missed Connection Rejec:
After a thorough review of your case, we regret to inform you that we are
unable to pursue your compensation claim. The disruption recorded for your
flight does not meet the minimum delay threshold required under the applicable
passenger rights regulations, and no missed connection was identified as a
consequence of the delay. Therefore, your case does not qualify for
compensation at this time.
rejectionTemplates.No Disruption Found Rejection:
After a thorough review of your case, we regret to inform you that we are
unable to identify any recorded disruption for the flight(s) in question.
Without verifiable evidence of a qualifying disruption, we are unable to
pursue a compensation claim on your behalf.
rejectionTemplates.Jurisdiction expired Rejection:
After a thorough review of your case, we regret to inform you that the
applicable limitation period for filing a compensation claim for this flight
has expired. Under the relevant passenger rights regulations and national law,
claims must be submitted within a specific time frame from the date of the
disruption. Unfortunately, your case falls outside this window and we are
unable to take further action.
rejectionTemplates.Disrupted & Affected Flights Not Under S:
After a thorough review of your case, we regret to inform you that the
disrupted flight and the affected connecting flight were not booked under the
same reservation. Under the applicable passenger rights regulations,
compensation for a missed connection is only available when all flights are
part of a single through-ticket or booking. As the flights were booked
separately, we are unable to pursue a compensation claim in this instance.
